verdict.rationale: Parsec documents a Teams API for automating deployment, reporting and audit-log access. However, the API is limited to the Teams/Enterprise tier and covers admin functions, with no evidence it matches what the UI can do. Probes found no public OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for core session/connection/hosting functions, documented UI-API parity, consumer-tier API access, published API reference/OpenAPI spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
